conviction_note: Event and session re-confirmed from the company PR. Against a 20.7% event-implied move I only claim a modest signed lean, because my hard evidence is thin: the one externally verifiable input to ODDITY's entire recovery thesis (its largest ad partner's own clearing price) was disclosed on 2026-07-29, after ODDITY last guided, and shows no deflation at all, while the stock has re-rated 36% off its low to 21-32% ABOVE the $10.09-$11.07 sell-side consensus target and the option surface is paying 16.19 vol points more for calls than puts. Findings 1 and 3 are one directional bet, not two, so -3.5 is not their sum.

findings.finding: Meta's own Q2 2026 release (2026-07-29, 57 days after ODDITY last guided) shows average price per ad +12% y/y -- identical to Q1 2026 -- with ad impressions growth decelerating from +19% to +14%, i.e. the auction ODDITY blames for its CPA blow-up is still inflating at an unchanged rate while inventory growth slows; ODDITY's whole Q2/H2 case rests on its 'largest advertising partner' delivering an estimated 40-60% CPA recovery through system fixes.
findings.why_not_priced: No ODD preview cross-reads Meta's price-per-ad line; the sell-side ODD note quotes ODDITY's own May CPA datapoint (-28% sequential vs April) and stops there. If the market had connected the two, the front-expiry 25-delta skew would not be at -16.19 vol points (calls bid over puts) on a name whose last two earnings reactions were -49% and -30%, and the stock would not be trading 21-32% above the $10.09-$11.07 consensus price target after a 36% rally off the 52-week low.
findings.independence: Similarweb shows ilmakiage.com traffic still declining -4.73% month-over-month with display advertising still the single largest channel at 28.84% of visits -- i.e. no visible re-scaling of the paid funnel. https://www.similarweb.com/website/ilmakiage.com/ (read 2026-09-08). Separately, ilmakiage.com's US homepage carries only a routine '10% off your first purchase' email capture and free shipping over $50, no clearance posture, so the traffic decline is a demand/acquisition read rather than a discount-driven one (https://www.ilmakiage.com/, read 2026-09-08).

findings.finding: On 2026-09-03 a single line -- the October 16 2026 $7.50 put -- printed 24,001 contracts, 99.9% of the day's total ODD options volume and 2.8x the entire pre-existing open interest of 8,509, at a strike 48.4% below the then-spot of $14.54; on the same day the 3-month 90/110 skew FELL 4.76 percentage points to 0.73, which is the direction skew moves when size is sold to dealers, not bought.
findings.why_not_priced: The published framing of this print is 'defensive positioning', which is the opposite of what the skew actually did on the day. A market genuinely braced for a third leg down after -49% and -30% would show downside skew rising into the print and puts bid; instead the front expiry pays 16.19 vol points more for calls and a customer appears to have underwritten 2.4m shares of downside below $7.50. If the tail were hedged, a miss would be cushioned; it is not, so a miss gaps further than the 20.7% implied.
findings.independence: none that is genuinely separate -- this restates, from a different expiry and instrument, the same fact the sealed baseline already records as skew_25d_vol_points -16.19. Treat this and finding 1 as ONE directional bet: finding 1 is the reason to lean down, this is only the reason the down-case pays more than symmetric. Do not add the two impacts.

findings.finding: The sealed baseline's eight-print history is wrong and only two of the eight 6-Ks are earnings: 2026-08-21 is the appointment of director David S. Cohen, 2026-07-30 is the AGM voting results, 2026-06-12/06-16 are the AGM proxy statement and proxy card, and 2026-03-12 is the $200m buyback authorisation -- leaving 2026-02-25 (-49.21%) and 2026-06-02 (-29.61%) as the only real earnings reactions, both of which are larger in absolute terms than the 20.7% currently implied.
findings.why_not_priced: This carries no direction and is not a claim about the business -- it is a correction to the ranking input. It matters because the recorded 6.25% median reaction and the 3-of-8 up-count would otherwise make ODD look like a low-magnitude name; the true earnings-reaction sample is n=2 and both observations exceed the option chain's 20.7%, with an ATM bid-ask of 41.5% of mid making that 20.7% indicative at best. Rank ODD's magnitude above, not below, its implied move.
findings.independence: Corroborated by the other filing documents in the same EDGAR cluster: the AGM proxy card exhibit at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907085/000110465926074646/tm2617842d2_ex99-2.htm (2026-06-16) and the AGM results 6-K at https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907085/000110465926088687/tm2621598d1_6k.htm (2026-07-30). These are one source cluster (the EDGAR filing set), not three independent sources.

findings.finding: ODDITY has pushed both 2026 interim reports roughly five weeks later than the prior year -- Q1 from 2025-04-29 to 2026-06-02 (+34 days) and Q2 from 2025-08-04 to 2026-09-09 (+36 days) -- while leaving the Q4/FY date untouched at February 25 in both 2025 and 2026, and has switched from after-close release with a next-morning call to a same-morning pre-open release.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody aggregates a reporting-date shift; the calendar row just says 2026-09-09. The benign reading is that management wants maximum evidence before speaking and will guide Q3 with ~77% of the quarter already elapsed, which would argue for a safer guide. I weight that reading down because it is directly falsified by 2026-02-25, when management guided Q1 to -30% with ~62% of the quarter already known and still gapped the stock 49%. The remaining information is that the delay is confined precisely to the two crisis quarters. If the market read this as a stabilisation signal, ODD would not still sit above every published price target on a Hold consensus.
findings.independence: The Q2 dates are separately verifiable: 2025-08-04 at https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/07/23/3120617/0/en/ODDITY-to-Announce-Second-Quarter-2025-Financial-Results-on-August-4-2025.html and 2026-09-09 at https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/07/22/3331716/0/en/oddity-to-announce-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-on-september-9-2026.html. Same issuer, so this is one source cluster.

searched_and_found_nothing: Insider activity: every Form 4 and Form 144 in the 2026-08-26 to 2026-09-03 cluster is CFO Lindsay Drucker Mann exercising $9.39 options and selling under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-03-13 (~52k shares at $14.27-$15.14). Pre-planned, mechanical, no signal. No CEO/founder sales in the window. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1907085/000110465926104012/tm2624200-3_4seq1.xml

Ownership: BlackRock filed a NEW SCHEDULE 13G on 2026-07-29 and Morgan Stanley a 13G/A on 2026-08-13, but the 10.6% reduction in Class A shares from the Q1 buyback mechanically pushes sub-5% passive holders through the threshold, so I could not separate conviction accumulation from arithmetic. https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001907085.json

FY2025 annual report: I chased the possibility that ODDITY had failed to file one, since insiders began filing Forms 3/4 (event date 2026-03-18) as if Section 16 applied while the company kept filing 6-Ks. The 20-F was in fact filed 2026-03-17. Whatever the filer-status anomaly is, it produced no missed disclosure and no tradeable consequence for this print.

Company sources: oddity.com/careers, oddity.com/brands and investors.oddity.com all return HTTP 403 to this environment, so I could not do the headcount/job-posting or brand-pipeline read that would have been the most direct demand proxy.
New brand launch: nothing since METHODIQ (Nov 2025); Brand 4 is still 'next year' per the last public commentary, so there is no launch catalyst in this print.

Israeli-language press (Calcalist, Globes, Bizportal) since 2026-06-02: the only ODDITY-specific item is a 2026-06-23 retrospective; the hiring-freeze mention is from 2026-05-24, before the last guide, and there is no reported layoff event.

Meta Ad Library active-ad count for IL MAKIAGE (403), Apple App Store listings for SpoiledChild/METHODIQ (404) -- the app and ad-creative volume trail, which is the cleanest read on whether paid acquisition has been re-scaled, was not reachable.

Similarweb monthly time series: only a 3-month aggregate (2.3m visits) and a -4.73% MoM figure were public, with no year-ago comparison, so I could not size the traffic decline against the -25/-30% revenue guide.

Buyback pace in Q2: $167.3m remained authorised at 2026-03-31 after $82.3m/6.1m shares in Q1. The programme is in the wire and the Q2 pace is not knowable before the print, so the mechanical share-count tailwind to adjusted EPS is not an edge.
Any post-2026-06-02 management appearance, conference fireside or pre-announcement: none found in 99 days of silence.
baseline_tension: It cuts against the baseline: the 25-delta skew of -16.19 says the market is paying materially more for upside, and the tape agrees (+5.13% over 20 days, 36% off the low, trading above every published price target), while the only externally verifiable input to the recovery thesis -- Meta's own +12% price per ad, unchanged from Q1 and disclosed after ODDITY last guided -- does not confirm it; the one place I agree with the baseline is that the 20.7% implied move is probably too small, since the only two genuine earnings reactions this company has ever produced were -49.2% and -29.6%.
